figure.teaching_claim: A 205-sample spectral frame supplies evidence before the named 320-received-sample duration boundary; KEY is reachable only after spectral and persistent temporal gates both pass.
figure.embed: <Figure name="DtmfFeatureTimingPipeline" alt="A synthetic key-5 signal passes through the 101-tap course FIR, a 205-sample rectangular feature frame produces eight declared spectral coordinates, and a separate temporal state accumulates at least 320 received samples before frequency, dominance, twist, pause, and interruption gates can return KEY or REJECT." caption="Spectral evidence may arrive before temporal qualification; one 205-sample frame cannot by itself satisfy a 320-sample duration gate." />

exact_contract.synthetic_source: key 5 = 770 Hz + 1336 Hz at f_s=8000 Hz
exact_contract.course_fir: 101-tap synthetic 300-3400 Hz course FIR, explicitly not Q.24
exact_contract.source_to_received_delay: 50 samples = 6.25 ms; shown between source origin and received-signal origin
exact_contract.coordinates: eight declared coordinates from one family only: exact C(f) or declared grid bins
spectral_gates: frequency: named AT&T operate offset <=+/-1.5%, non-operate from +/-3.5%
twist: named AT&T high-minus-low range -8 to +4 dB
exact_contract.temporal_state: >=320 received samples =40 ms; visibly longer than N=205 and persistent across blocks
temporal_gates: duration: named AT&T operation side >=40 ms
outputs: spectral pass AND temporal pass -> KEY
any failed or ambiguous gate -> REJECT
exact_contract.latency_guardrail: The 40 ms duration clock begins at received-signal onset; the separate 6.25 ms FIR delay is not folded into that bar.

semantic_roles.amber: synthetic source, 205-sample spectral feature frame, and spectral-pass path
semantic_roles.blue: received-signal origin, 320-sample persistent temporal state, and temporal-pass path

accessibility: Every colored lane and terminal is named in text.
The 205 and 320 spans differ in length, endpoint labels, and solid/dashed continuation, not color alone.
KEY and REJECT use literal labels, check/X symbols, and solid/dashed outlines.
Inline SVG rails have role=img and factual aria-label values.
Mobile layout preserves all required numbers, gates, origins, and outputs at both 312 and 360 px.

responsive_contract.mechanism: CSS container queries plus optional 312/360 render-harness width; no React hooks
responsive_contract.desktop: Source and FIR align horizontally; spectral and temporal lanes remain parallel; both converge at one AND/output block.
responsive_contract.mobile: Source precedes FIR vertically, then the feature lane, temporal lane, AND block, KEY, and REJECT. The origin-delay bracket remains between FIR and the received-origin lanes.
responsive_contract.narrow_exception: At <=330 px only the redundant internal footer sentence is hidden to keep the standalone harness from clipping; all required labels and data remain.

defects_seen: The mobile source-to-FIR arrow was rotated at the outer grid item, escaped above the heading, and created excess vertical space.
At 312 px the standalone 1400 px-high harness clipped the redundant footer sentence.
fixes: Moved mobile rotation from each outer grid item to the arrow glyph itself.
Hid only the redundant internal footer below 331 px; required content remains visible.

render_look_fix.verdict: PASS: no clipping, collision, broken KaTeX, misaligned arrows, theme loss, or premature KEY path.
